title: Harness-G: A Graph-Structured Harness for Search Agents
abstract: arXiv:2607.27652v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) search agents commonly model retrieval as free-form natural-language query generation and optimize multi-turn interactions using final-answer rewards. Current studies mainly improve training with denser or more structured credit signals, but rarely examine whether retrieval is properly formulated at the policy-environment interface. We observe pronounced retrieval aliasing during Search-R1 training: rollouts for the same question continue to generate distinct query strings, yet their accumulated evidence sets increasingly overlap. We call this phenomenon retrieval-equivalence collapse; in this regime, trajectories approach utility equivalence with respect to retrieval decisions, leaving within-group returns with little effective retrieval contrast. To address this problem, we propose Harness-G, a graph-structured retrieval framework that redesigns this interface. It reformulates free-form query generation

translated_title: Harness-G：一种用于搜索智能体的图结构检索框架
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）搜索智能体通常将检索建模为自由形式的自然语言查询生成，并使用最终答案奖励来优化多轮交互。当前研究主要通过更密集或更结构化的信用信号来改进训练，但很少检查检索在策略-环境接口处是否被正确定义。我们在Search-R1训练期间观察到显著的检索混淆现象：同一问题的展开轨迹持续生成不同的查询字符串，但它们累积的证据集越来越重叠。我们将这种现象称为检索等价性崩溃；在这种状态下，轨迹在检索决策方面趋近于效用等价，导致组内回报缺乏有效的检索对比。为解决此问题，我们提出Harness-G，一种图结构检索框架，重新设计了这个接口。它重新构建了自由形式的查询生成过程。
tldr: 本文提出Harness-G，一种图结构检索框架，通过重新设计策略-环境接口来解决搜索智能体训练中的检索等价性崩溃问题，从而增强检索决策的对比性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Harness-G, a graph-structured retrieval framework that redesigns the policy-environment interface to address retrieval-equivalence collapse in search agent training, thereby enhancing contrast among retrieval decisions.
